**7B.4 Research Note: Bongbong Marcos in 2024**

**Assessment:** mixed, leaning negative on hidden family benefit. I did **not** find strong direct proof in the 2024 record of Marcos personally taking bribes, opaque-foundation money, or a clearly documented hidden asset scheme. I **did** find credible evidence of family-linked political/business advantage, especially around media and state-adjacent influence, plus a regulatory environment where rent-seeking remained possible.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Positive | [EO 52 institutionalizing the Pag-Abot Program](https://mirror.pia.gov.ph/press-releases/2024/01/22/pbbm-issues-eo-no-52-institutionalizing-and-expanding-dswds-pag-abot-program-for-street-dwellers-other-poor-and-vulnerable-individuals) | Presidential Communications Office via PIA | 2024-01-22 | Marcos routed a major social program through an inter-agency committee, monitoring, and formal reporting. That is evidence against discretionary, family-style extraction from welfare spending. | 7B.4, 7B.3 |
| Positive | [New Government Procurement Act](https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1229520) | Philippine News Agency | 2024-07-22 | The procurement law standardized purchasing and was explicitly framed as reducing graft opportunities. This is strong evidence against using public contracts as a private or family enrichment channel. | 7B.4, 7B.3 |
| Positive | [EO 74 / total POGO ban](https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1237414) | Philippine News Agency | 2024-11-08 | Marcos formally banned offshore gaming operations, including illegal ones, on public-order grounds. That cuts against the idea that he was protecting a rent-generating sector for allies or relatives. | 7B.4, 7B.3 |
| Positive | [No loophole in EO 74, POGO ban in all forms](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-refutes-alleged-loophole-in-eo-74-reiterates-pogo-ban-in-all-forms/) | Presidential Communications Office | 2024-11-11 | Marcos publicly denied any loophole that would preserve POGO activity. That is a direct anti-rent statement and a useful counterweight to capture claims. | 7B.4, 7B.3 |
| Negative | [Digital News Report 2024: Philippines](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/philippines) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | The report says TeleRadyo Serbisyo entered a joint venture with Prime Media, which is associated with the Romualdez family. This is the clearest 2024 sign I found of politically connected business expansion under the Marcos administration. | 7B.4, 7B.3 |
| Negative | [Digital News Report 2024: Philippines](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/philippines) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | The same report says regulatory power over broadcasters remained politically salient, including franchise pressure and NTC action. That does not prove a direct kickback, but it shows office-linked leverage still had value to connected actors. | 7B.4, 7B.3 |
| Negative | [Marcos-Romualdez parties forge political alliance](https://www.bworldonline.com/the-nation/2024/05/08/593686/marcos-romualdez-parties-forge-political-alliance/) | BusinessWorld Online | 2024-05-08 | Marcos’s party and cousin Martin Romualdez’s party formed a formal alliance in Malacañang for the 2025 midterms. This is not proof of private enrichment, but it is strong evidence that family power and state power remained tightly intertwined. | 7B.4, 7B.3 |
| Negative | [Possible collusion among rice importers flagged by House panel](https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1239684) | Philippine News Agency | 2024-12-10 | A House panel flagged possible collusion among major rice importers after tariff cuts. This is not a Marcos-bribe finding, but it shows a major policy area stayed vulnerable to rent extraction and insider gains. | 7B.4, 7B.3 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find a reliable 2024 report showing Marcos or a close family member receiving a bribe, holding an opaque foundation, or directly skimming state assets.
- I also did not find a strong, source-backed allegation of a hidden Marcos-family asset transfer in 2024 itself.
- The evidence base is therefore mostly about **family-linked access and politically connected advantage**, not proven personal cash enrichment.

**Bottom line**
- The record does **not** show clean separation from family-linked advantage.
- It also does **not** give solid direct proof of classic personal profiteering such as bribes, hidden assets, or opaque foundations in 2024.
- The safest reading is: **no strong direct theft case found, but meaningful evidence of family-network advantage and rent-prone governance remains.**
